positions.title: Student Computing Technician
positions.description:
* Provided technical support and training to students, faculty, and staff, both in person and via phone/e-mail
* Residential Network Proctor during Summer 2008, on-site support for Harvard Summer School students
* Promoted to supervising position as of Fall 2010

positions.title: On-call Peer Tutor
positions.description: Tutoring other Harvard students in intro-level science courses (Physics of Music and Sound)

positions.title: Editorial Intern
positions.description:
* Transcribed, edited, and compiled the manuscript for a youth literary anthology, "WordPlay," based on in-class workshops
* Generated statistics from student, teacher, and parent response surveys using SPSS (assisting in preparation of grant reports for National Endowment for the Arts and other funders)

projects.title: Paper Machines
projects.description: Developing a tool to apply topic models, geoparsers, citation extractors, and other Natural Language Processing methods to a corpus from Zotero.
